name: SVC_BI_ACTION_PLAN_ACTIONS
description: This table is used for BI to store the action plan actions owners.

columns.name: BI_ACTION_PLAN_ACTION_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: ACTION_PLAN_ACTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the action plan actions and alternate key for this table.

columns.name: ACTION_OWNER_ID
columns.description: Indicates the consolidated Action Owner ID. Loaded from SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS.ASIGNEE_RESOURCE_ID for service requests related rows and from ZMM_ACTY_ACTIVITIES.OWNER_ID for activities related records.

columns.name: ACTION_OWNER_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the date and time the ESS job started, during which the record was created or last updated.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ACTION_OBJECT_ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: Indicates Action Object Entity Name. Loaded from SVC_AP_ACTIONS.OBJECT_ENTITY_NAME.

columns.name: ACTION_OBJECT_DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is logically deleted (Y or N). Loaded from SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS.DELETED_FLAG for service requests related rows and default setup to ‘N’ for activities related records.

columns.name: BI_DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this row is logically deleted (Y or N).
